fields.System.Title: OUT-507 — Void and repack a carton
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a packer, I want to void a closed carton and pack it again, so that an error found
after labelling can be corrected without breaking the audit trail.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a labelled carton not yet shipped, when I void it, then it is marked void
  • with a reason and its label is invalidated.
  • - Given a void, then the original carton record is retained — it is never edited or
  • deleted.
  • - Given the voided contents, then they return to the pack station for repacking into a
  • new carton.
  • - Given a shipped carton, then voiding is rejected.
  • - Given the void, then the acting user and reason are recorded.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | outbound |
| Tables | carton, carton_content |
| Risks | Reopening a carton breaking "what was in the box?" ([doc 05 WF 7](../../../docs/05-workflows.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration |
